items.title: Booking (NASDAQ:BKNG) reports sales below analyst estimates in Q3 2026 earnings
items.summary: Online travel agency Booking Holdings (NASDAQ:BKNG) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue falling 1.3% year on year to $8.89 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.66 per share was 3.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Booking Profit, Sales Fall as Global Conflicts Wear on Travel Demand
items.summary: The online travel agency posted a third-quarter profit of $2.72 billion, or $3.61 a share, as revenue fell 1% to $8.89 billion.

items.title: Booking Holdings shares fall as revenue miss and travel outlook weigh on sentiment
items.summary: Investing.com -- Booking Holdings shares fell 2% in after-hours trading on Tuesday as weaker-than-expected third-quarter revenue and a subdued fourth-quarter forecast raised concerns about slowing international travel demand, overshadowing a stronger-than-expected performance in adjusted earnings and gross bookings.
